title: groups render_delete vs _join_key TOCTOU: join can mutate detached record of deleted group
description: groups_collection.py:682-688,705,731: render_delete does check-then-del with NO lock; _join_key captures item at :705 before acquiring at :731, so delete mid-join leaves join mutating a detached record and returning CONTENT with key material for a deleted group. Take the lock around delete; re-fetch item inside _join_key span.
